source.notes: 모노블록, a palm-sized aluminium Bluetooth speaker (fictional)

rationale.palette: A bright product studio: a warm light-grey stage #ECEAE6 with a deeper floor tone #DEDBD5, graphite text #1C1E22, and one accent, vermilion #E0502D (the button, the status light, the brand word). The four finishes from the brief are the product colours: graphite #2E3136, sand #CDBFA8, sage #8FA392 and vermilion. The beat scene turns the lights down onto a night stage #121316 so the equaliser can glow.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable only: ExtraBold for the brand word (also extruded in 3D) and the lines, Medium for labels and the fine print, set on the left of a centred product.
rationale.motion: A product reel in real 3D: the brand word flies in letter by letter from depth while the camera arcs in and focus pulls onto it; the speaker turns under a key light that sweeps across its aluminium; it comes apart along its depth into an exploded view with leader lines landing on beats; the four colours step past in a cover flow; on a night stage the equaliser and rings pulse on every beat. Springs settle with little overshoot; 3D transitions (depth push, cube, flip board, fold, flip) move from side to side of one object.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in E major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): pad, glass, bell, bass and a full kit; glassy SFX for the metal (whooshes on the turns, blips on each label, a shimmer at the end).
rationale.visuals: Solid 3D (runtime g3.js): lit meshes with physical materials (anodised metal, clearcoat letters), soft shadows on a shadow-catcher floor, a mirror floor for the hero, depth of field, an exploded view, instanced equaliser bars. Copy, labels and leader lines are 2D on top.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short launch reel whose labels carry the facts.
